definitions.explanation: The area where visitors are received and directed.
The person who works at the reception desk.
The act of receiving applications, registrations, etc.

examples.japanese: {受付|うけつけ}はあちらです。
examples.english: The reception desk is over there.

examples.japanese: {受付|うけつけ}で{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write your name at the reception desk.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}に{着|つ}いたら、まず{受付|うけつけ}に{行|い}って{名前|なまえ}と{症状|しょうじょう}を{伝|つた}えてください。
examples.english: When you arrive at the hospital, first go to the reception desk and tell them your name and symptoms.

examples.japanese: {受付|うけつけ}の{人|ひと}に{聞|き}いてください。
{受付|うけつけ}の{方|かた}がとても{親切|しんせつ}だった。
{分|わ}からないことがあったら、{受付|うけつけ}の{人|ひと}に{聞|き}けば{教|おし}えてもらえる。
examples.english: If there's something you don't understand, you can ask the receptionist and they'll help you.

examples.japanese: {受付|うけつけ}は{何時|なんじ}までですか。
examples.english: Until what time is registration open?

examples.japanese: {申|もう}し{込|こ}みの{受付|うけつけ}は{終|お}わりました。
イベントの{受付|うけつけ}{開始|かいし}は{午前|ごぜん}{九時|くじ}からなので、{早|はや}めに{行|い}ったほうがいい。
examples.english: Registration for the event starts at 9 a.m., so it's better to go early.

notes:
{受付|うけつけ} can refer to the reception desk, the receptionist, or the act of accepting/registering.

Derived from: {受|う}け{付|つ}ける (to accept, to receive)

Common collocations:
- {受付|うけつけ}で: at the reception desk
- {受付|うけつけ}{時間|じかん}: reception hours
- {受付|うけつけ}{開始|かいし}: start of registration
- {受付|うけつけ}{終了|しゅうりょう}: end of registration
- {受付|うけつけ}{番号|ばんごう}: reception number (ticket number)

Usage: Found in hospitals, hotels, offices, event venues, etc.
